thread:
anya (PM): Quick thread: planning a staged rollout for model-routing flags. Goals: tenant pin, internal-only dry-run, metric gates, and a clear fallback ladder. thoughts?

dave (Eng): 👍. Proposal: three stages — internal dry-run (org staff), canary (1% orgs), ramp (10% orgs). Gates: p95 latency, error delta, and quality metric.

marta (Infra): need warm pools per region (EU/us-west). prewarm = 10% expected traffic, autoscale buffer +15%. Note: EU-hosted option if legal requires.

li (SRE): fallback ladder: auto soft-route (new sessions to baseline) on metric breach; freeze-rollout; full-revert requires 2 approvals. Alerting rules to page on full-revert.

sam (SE): telemetry list: p95, p99.9, prefix-cache-hit, token-per-request, quality-delta, sampled outputs 1/1k. Dashboard per-slice.

jen (Legal): confirm data residency for EU. If variant hits non-EU infra for EU orgs we need consent or EU-only variant. Provide third-party list.

anya (PM): action items: sales/legal deck, flag UI pin, ops dashboard, EU cost estimate. Target signoff Fri EOD.

deploy-bot: scheduled: dry-run 2026-04-07T09:00Z -> canary 2026-04-08T02:00Z (1%). CI gates: unit + perf + telemetry. :rocket:
